newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on firm cash, soybean gain.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on firm cash, soybean gain.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on firm cash markets and on gains in soybean futures, traders said.
"Cash markets remain above the board price. The cash market nearby is still $11.00 per cwt at the farm level," a trader said.
Rice futures have been rangebound and are showing a firm tone partly in an attempt to bring supply into the pipeline, they said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, up from 107 Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice options volume was estimated at 20 contracts, up from zero Wednesday.
Rice futures closed three to six cents per cwt higher, with September up four at $10.35 per cwt.
